اسأليني-عن-اسمك-bana-adini-sor-2015.synopsis: Yasemin and Hakan, inseparable since growing up together in a children’s home, share a bond forged by friendship and Yasemin’s unspoken love for Hakan. When the arrival of Merve disrupts their world, an unforeseen tragedy awaits Hakan.

sukma-2025.title: Sukma
sukma-2025.synopsis: Arini and her family went to a small town to start a new life, but it turns into a disaster after they find an ancient mirror in a secret warehouse.

welcome-now-get-lost-2025.title: Welcome, Now Get Lost
welcome-now-get-lost-2025.synopsis: Facing a whirlwind of emotions, comedians endure relentless insults from angry villagers. Can they turn hostility into laughter?

shark-the-beginning-2021.title: Shark: The Beginning
shark-the-beginning-2021.synopsis: A bullied teenager who is locked up at a juvenile detention center due to an unexpected accident, meets a mixed martial arts champion to break through his own limits.

the-day-a-pig-fell-into-the-well-1996.title: The Day a Pig Fell Into the Well

the-day-a-pig-fell-into-the-well-1996.originalTitle: The Day a Pig Fell Into the Well 1996
the-day-a-pig-fell-into-the-well-1996.synopsis: The lives of 4 interconnected South Koreans – a married couple, a novelist the wife is having an affair with, and a second woman the novelist is simultaneously involved with.

love-exposure-2008.title: Love Exposure
love-exposure-2008.synopsis: The story of a teenage boy called Yu, who falls for Yoko, a girl he runs into while operating for the sake of sin as an upskirt photographer in an offshoot of the porn industry. His attempts to woo her are complicated by a spot of cross-dressing - which convinces Yoko that she is lesbian - dalliances with kung-fu and crime, and a constant struggle with the guilt that's a legacy of his Catholic upbringing.

panda-plan-2024.title: Panda Plan
panda-plan-2024.synopsis: تدور احداث الفيلم حين يتم دعوة نجم الكونغ فو الشهير (جاكي شان) لتبني باندا تدعى (هوهو) من حديقة الحيوانات، ولكن عصابة إجرامية تضع مكافأة كبيرة لمن يخطف (هوهو)، مما يجعل (جاكي) يتعاون مع وكيله وحارس الباندا لحمايتها ومواجهة العصابة في مغامرة شاقة.

cottontail-2023.title: Cottontail
cottontail-2023.synopsis: After the death of his wife, Kenzaburō receives an unexpected letter from beyond the grave. His late wife asks him to travel to Lake Windermere in England with their son to scatter her ashes. Plagued by sweet and painful memories of his wife, Kenzaburō travels to England from Tokyo to fulfill her final wish, but the father and son's fraught relationship threatens to upend their journey.

chime-2024.title: Chime
chime-2024.synopsis: A chef's life is disrupted by a chime that brings with it an increasing sense of dread.

my-name-is-loh-kiwan-2024.title: My Name Is Loh Kiwan
my-name-is-loh-kiwan-2024.synopsis: بعد الانشقاق عن "كوريا الشمالية"، يجاهد "لو كيوان" لنيل الموافقة على طلب اللجوء في "بلجيكا"، حيث يلتقي بامرأة يائسة فقدت كل أمل لها في الحياة.

jai-chiranjeeva-2005.title: Jai Chiranjeeva
jai-chiranjeeva-2005.synopsis: Sathya lives with his large family which also includes his niece, Lavanya. When Lavanya is killed by gun dealer Pasupathi, Sathya travels to the USA to avenge her death.

sundarakanda-2025.title: Sundarakanda
sundarakanda-2025.synopsis: A man born under the Mula Nakshatra faces misfortune and failed relationships, exploring his journey to win over his ideal match.

taandob-2025.title: Taandob
taandob-2025.synopsis: A group of masked assailants storms the office of the country’s top television channel, taking the staff and a prominent minister, who was there for an interview, hostage. While the nation's law enforcement agencies race to uncover the identity of the mastermind behind the attack, the mastermind reveals himself live on the channel’s program, exposing the stories of ordinary people who have fallen victim to high-level corruption. Thus begins a rampage against the injustices of the system.

vaamana-2025.title: Vaamana
vaamana-2025.synopsis: Explores the emotions and lifestyles of ordinary people, with a compelling hero Guna pursuing vengeance against antagonists. His actions are driven by his past life, which influences his present and future.

blackia-2-2024.title: Blackia 2
blackia-2-2024.synopsis: A young man from a village rises through the ranks of the underworld.

coffee-with-a-killer-2025.title: Coffee with a Killer
coffee-with-a-killer-2025.synopsis: In 'Coffee with a Killer', a ruthless man receives a contract for an illegal activity. On this mission, he enters a coffee shop and observes his surroundings. Each table is filled with many stories. Who is the hitman's target? How does he do the job?

hasee-toh-phasee-2014.title: Hasee Toh Phasee
hasee-toh-phasee-2014.synopsis: يتقابل (نيكهيل) و(ميتا) بعد عشر سنوات من لقائهم الأول، ومن أجل الفوز بقلبها، يتعين على (نيكهيل) إثبات جدارته بالزواج منها من خلال مجموعة من الاختبارات على مدار 10 أيام.

ala-vaikunthapurramuloo-2020.title: Ala Vaikunthapurramuloo
ala-vaikunthapurramuloo-2020.synopsis: After growing up enduring criticism from his father, a young man finds his world shaken upon learning he was switched at birth with a millionaire's son.

phullwanti-2024.title: Phullwanti
phullwanti-2024.synopsis: An esteemed, prestigious court dancer is challenged by the holistic views of society as she is seen as an impure woman who just entertains, but the dancer decides to go against the grain and prove to the people that it's their view what's impure, not her.

the-miranda-brothers-2024.title: The Miranda Brothers
the-miranda-brothers-2024.synopsis: An orphan rescued from trash becomes devoted to his elder brother in a Goan suburb run by a drug gang, both growing to be star footballers - till suspicious death of their mother threatens to tear them apart.

double-ismart-2024.title: Double Ismart
double-ismart-2024.synopsis: Big Bull, a notorious assassin, wants to achieve immortality by transferring his memories to "iSmart" Shankar, who already has another's person's memories, leading to the intense confrontation between Shankar and Big Bull.

mr-mrs-mahi-2024.title: Mr. & Mrs. Mahi
mr-mrs-mahi-2024.synopsis: Poles apart, Mahima and Mahendra find a unifying force in the form of cricket. While one Mahi (Mahendra) is grappling to come to terms with his dream of playing for India getting shattered, he wants to live it through the other Mahi (Mahima.) Mahima is a doctor but Mahendra hasn't seen anyone play like her. Will the clash of dreams unite Mr. and Mrs. Mahi or create boundaries for life?

pindam-2023.title: Pindam
pindam-2023.synopsis: A powerful spirit that had never seen the face of earth, begins to threaten the life of a six-year-old girl with speech impairment. It's up to Annamma, the only demonologist, to rescue the family and uncover the spirit's true intentions.

sam-bahadur-2023.title: Sam Bahadur
sam-bahadur-2023.synopsis: Based on the life of Sam Manekshaw, who was the Chief of the Army Staff of the Indian Army during the Indo-Pakistani War of 1971, and the first Indian Army officer to be promoted to the rank of Field Marshal.

time-of-death-2026.title: Time of Death
time-of-death-2026.synopsis: When a prisoner vanishes without a trace, Detective Frank Morley (Michael Kelly) is sent to a decaying prison on the verge of shutdown. What begins as a routine investigation quickly spirals into a dangerous search for answers.

true-justice-eye-for-an-eye-2026.title: True Justice: Eye For An Eye
true-justice-eye-for-an-eye-2026.titleEn: True Justice: Eye For An Eye
true-justice-eye-for-an-eye-2026.originalTitle: True Justice: Eye For An Eye 2026
true-justice-eye-for-an-eye-2026.synopsis: Amateur sleuths tackle a fresh challenge at a local school, diving into the fierce world of parent politics. Their investigation uncovers hidden agendas and unexpected alliances as they navigate the complex web within the community.

driver-s-ed-2026.title: Driver’s Ed
driver-s-ed-2026.synopsis: A group of teens hit the road in a stolen driver's ed car, racing against time to help a lovesick high school senior track down his college-freshman girlfriend and win her back.

reflection-in-a-dead-diamond-2025.title: Reflection in a Dead Diamond
reflection-in-a-dead-diamond-2025.synopsis: When the mysterious woman in the room next door disappears, a debonair 70-year-old ex-spy living in a luxury hotel on the Côte d'Azur is confronted by the demons and darlings of a lurid past in which moviemaking, memories and madness collide.

the-girl-in-the-spider-s-web-2018.title: The Girl in the Spider’s Web

the-girl-in-the-spider-s-web-2018.originalTitle: The Girl in the Spider’s Web 2018

colours-of-time-2025.title: Colours of Time
colours-of-time-2025.synopsis: United by the unexpected inheritance of a house in Normandy, four estranged cousins discover their family history by retracing their ancestor's steps.

the-carman-family-deaths-2025.title: The Carman Family Deaths
the-carman-family-deaths-2025.synopsis: بعد عملية إنقاذ مثيرة لشابّ من عرض البحر، توجّه إليه أصابع الاتهام بقتل فردين من عائلته الثرية في "نيو إنغلاند"، في هذا الفيلم الوثائقي الذي يسلّط الضوء على جريمة حقيقية.

a-little-game-2014.title: A Little Game
a-little-game-2014.synopsis: Ostracized at her posh new uptown school and shaken by the death of her beloved grandmother, a 10-year-old downtown girl finds an unlikely mentor in an irascible chess master, who uses the game to teach Max lessons in resilience, perseverance, and how to embrace inevitable change.

queen-of-bones-2024.title: Queen of Bones
queen-of-bones-2024.synopsis: Twin siblings seek answers about their mother's death and her connection to the supernatural while living on a remote homestead with their father in 1931 Oregon.

a-scam-called-love-2025.title: A Scam Called Love
a-scam-called-love-2025.synopsis: An ambitious chef from South Africa enters a green card marriage with a cash-strapped line cook from Atlanta. The couple journey to Cape Town to gather proof of their relationship, only to find that deceiving the government is easy compared to fooling your own family.

boot-camp-2024.title: Boot Camp
boot-camp-2024.synopsis: Unathletic Whitney Carmichael signs up for an intense summer boot camp to reinvent herself and falls for her personal trainer. She then finds the strength to embrace her true self and ignore the others' expectations.

in-the-land-of-blood-and-honey-2011.title: In the Land of Blood and Honey
in-the-land-of-blood-and-honey-2011.titleEn: In the Land of Blood and Honey
in-the-land-of-blood-and-honey-2011.originalTitle: In the Land of Blood and Honey 2011
in-the-land-of-blood-and-honey-2011.synopsis: خلال حرب البوسنة ، دانيجل ، جندي يقاتل من أجل الصرب ، يعيد لقاء أجلا ، البوسني الذي أصبح الآن أسيرًا في معسكره الذي يشرف عليه. أصبحت علاقتهم الواعدة ذات يوم غامضة مع تغير دوافعهم.
in-the-land-of-blood-and-honey-2011.tagline: الحب يمكن أن يغير ما نريد ... الحرب يمكن أن تغير من نحن

diva-futura-2024.title: Diva Futura
diva-futura-2024.synopsis: In 1980s - 1990s Italy, Riccardo Schicchi’s agency Diva Futura turns free love into porn, making stars of Ilona Staller, Moana Pozzi and others known around the world. Their fame leads to Cicciolina’s election and Pozzi’s mayoral run.

عرض-sarah-silverman-postmortem-2025.title: Sarah Silverman: PostMortem
عرض-sarah-silverman-postmortem-2025.synopsis: بعد أن فقدت والديها، تجد "سارا سيلفرمان" عزاءها في الضحك وتخليد ذكراهما من خلال تفاصيل حياتهما، من مشاهدة مسلسلها المفضل مع والدها وهو على فراش الموت إلى إطلاق الريح في لحظة حرجة.

lawless-2012.title: Lawless
lawless-2012.synopsis: خلال فترة الكساد الكبير في الولايات المتحدة اﻷمريكية، يروي الفيلم قصة الإخوة (بوندوانت) الثلاثة المعروفين بسمعتهم السيئة وجرائمهم الشهيرة في ولاية فيرجينا وعمليات التهريب التي قاموا بها، إلى أن يأتي نائب شرطة جديد طامع في نسبة من أرباحهم، وينوي تحويل حياتهم إلى جحيم.

agent-game-2022.title: Agent Game
agent-game-2022.synopsis: هاريس، محقق تحقيقات في وكالة المخابرات المركزية في موقع سري، يجد نفسه هدفًا لعملية ترحيل بعد أن تم استخدامه كرميز لتحقيق ذهب على نحو فظيع. وبينما يبدأ الفريق المكلف بضبط هاريس في التساؤل حول توجيهاتهم - وحول بعضهم البعض - يرفع أولسن، ضابط المخابرات الكبير، وتابعه فيسر، الرهانات. الآن، يعود الأمر إلى هاريس وبعض الحلفاء الجدد لاكتشاف الحقيقة وتغيير الأمور.

beshenstvo-2023.title: Beshenstvo
beshenstvo-2023.synopsis: An unprecedented epidemic of rabies is breaking out in the taiga. Infected wolves become more and more ferocious, and even the slightest bite brings certain death. At the same time, a desperate father decides to forcibly isolate his son in one of the hunting lodges in order to save him from addiction. Soon, he and several local residents will have to fight not only with a rabid pack, but also with the most dangerous predator of the forest.

2010-the-other-guys.title: The Other Guys
2010-the-other-guys.synopsis: عندما يكون رجال الشرطة مشغولين ... أملنا الوحيد هو ... على عكس نظرائهم الأبطال في القوة ، لا يحصل محققو شرطة نيويورك المقيدين بالمكتب غامبل وهويتز على عناوين الصحف أثناء عملهم يوما بعد يوم. عندما تتحول قضية تبدو بسيطة إلى مشكلة كبيرة ، يحصل الشرطيان على فرصة ليثبتا أخيرا لرفاقهما أن لديهما الأشياء الصحيحة.

umjolo-my-beginnings-my-end-2025.title: Umjolo: My Beginnings, My End!
umjolo-my-beginnings-my-end-2025.synopsis: تبدأ "مايي"، العالقة بين عائلتها وحريتها، التشكيك في قرار زواجها المرتقب حين تتعرف على عازف الساكسفون الجذاب والشغوف.

the-sleeping-woman-2024.title: The Sleeping Woman
the-sleeping-woman-2024.synopsis: Ana, a nursing assistant, begins to feel attracted to Agustín, the husband of the woman in a vegetative state that she has been hired to take care of. Soon she begins to be harassed by strange paranormal phenomena that seem to try to throw her out of the house and separate her from Agustín.

the-children-s-train-2024.title: The Children’s Train
the-children-s-train-2024.synopsis: في إيطاليا خلال أواخر أربعينيات القرن الماضي، تتخذ أمّ قرارًا صعبًا فترسل ابنها إلى الشمال، حيث يتمكن من أن يعيش لمحات من حياة جديدة بعيدة عن الفقر.

paris-christmas-waltz-2023.title: Paris Christmas Waltz
paris-christmas-waltz-2023.synopsis: Emma relinquishes her job so a colleague with a family will keep his. Contemplating life’s next steps, Emma meets a professional dancer, Leo whose love for competitive dancing is waning, until a once in a lifetime opportunity arises for the novice to join the pro and sweep all of Paris off its feet.

casi-el-para-so-2024.title: Casi el Paraíso
casi-el-para-so-2024.synopsis: Ugo Conti, charismatic Italian aristocrat and influencer, arrives in Mexico where he seduces the Mexican high society. When he meets Frida Becker again, the love of his past, he will end up in the center of a struggle for political power.

the-doomsday-cult-of-antares-de-la-luz-2.title: The Doomsday Cult of Antares de la Luz
the-doomsday-cult-of-antares-de-la-luz-2.titleEn: The Doomsday Cult of Antares de la Luz
the-doomsday-cult-of-antares-de-la-luz-2.originalTitle: The Doomsday Cult of Antares de la Luz 2024
the-doomsday-cult-of-antares-de-la-luz-2.synopsis: Almost 10 years after being charged with a heinous crime, former members of a Chilean cult share their haunting experiences.

cypher-2023.title: Cypher
cypher-2023.synopsis: Cypher is a fictional pseudo-music documentary about the artist Tierra Whack and the conspiracy theory that secret societies run the music world.

the-last-repair-shop-2023.title: The Last Repair Shop
the-last-repair-shop-2023.synopsis: In a warehouse in the heart of Los Angeles, a dwindling handful of devoted craftspeople maintain more than 80,000 student musical instruments, the largest remaining workshop in America of its kind. Meet four unforgettable characters whose broken-and-repaired lives have been dedicated to bringing so much more than music to the schoolchildren of this city.

primbon-2023.title: Primbon
primbon-2023.synopsis: It starts with Rana and his best friend Janu who are climbing a mountain in bad weather. In the middle of a dense forest, they got separated and lost. Janu is lucky to be back home at last. But not with Rana. An extensive search was carried out. Rana not found. A week has passed. Rana's extended family decided to hold a tahlilan. Rana is considered unlikely to have survived and will surely die there. Dini  can't accept that. As a mother, Dini doesn't want to just give up and still believes that her daughter Rana is still alive. Sure enough. After the tahlilan, Rana came home in the pouring rain.

a-life-for-a-life.title: For Life
a-life-for-a-life.synopsis: يؤدّي "نيكولاس بينيك"  و"إنديرا فارما"  و"جوي براينت"  بطولة هذا المسلسل عن رجل يكافح لعكس مسار السجن عن غير وجه حقّ، والذي يعاني منه هو أيضًا. وتصفه جريدة "يو إس إيه توداي" بأنّه "ليس من صنف دراما المحاكم المعتادة".

creed-iii.title: Creed III
creed-iii.synopsis: تدور الأحداث في إطار درامي، ويعد هذا الجزء هو الثالث من سلسلة أفلام (كريد) التي تتناول حياة بطل الملاكمة (أدونيس كريد) ومبارياته الملهمة.

deep-fear.title: Deep Fear
deep-fear.synopsis: تدور أحداث الفيلم حول (نيومي) التي تذهب في رحلة بحرية وحدها لمقابلة حبيبها، إلا أن الرحلة تأخذ منعطفًا مظلمًا عندما تتعرض لعاصفة غير متوقعة، وتتوالى الأحداث.

mayfair-witches.title: Mayfair Witches
mayfair-witches.synopsis: تكتشف جراحة أعصاب أنها الوريثة المحتملة لعائلة من السحرة، ويصبح عليها مواجهة كيانًا مظلمًا يطارد عائلتها منذ زمن بعيد.

messi-meets-america.title: Messi Meets America
messi-meets-america.synopsis: انضموا إلى "ليونيل ميسي" وهو يبدأ فصلاً جديداً تاريخياً من حياته، ليجتاح بموهبته "أمريكا الشمالية" والدوري الأمريكي لكرة القدم، ويبدأ عصراً جديداً من اللعبة مع زملائه بفريق "إنتر ميامي".

naruto.title: NARUTO SD ロック・リーの青春フルパワー忍伝
naruto.titleEn: NARUTO SD ロック・リーの青春フルパワー忍伝
naruto.synopsis: أهلاً بكم في قرية الورق المخفية. القرية التي اتخذها أوزوماكي ناروتو، نجم مسلسل "ناروتو"، موطناً له. كل يوم، يقوم عدد لا يحصى من النينجا الأقوياء بمهام ويتدربون لصقل مهاراتهم.

on-a-wing-and-a-prayer.title: On a Wing and a Prayer
on-a-wing-and-a-prayer.titleEn: On a Wing and a Prayer
on-a-wing-and-a-prayer.originalTitle: On a Wing and a Prayer
on-a-wing-and-a-prayer.synopsis: يموت طيار في منتصف رحلة جوية بشكل مفاجئ، ويصبح على دوج وايت الهبوط بالطائرة بشكل آمن; على أمل إنقاذ عائلته وكافة الركاب.

poker-face.title: Poker Face
poker-face.synopsis: تمتلك تشارلي قدرة غير عادية على كشف الكذب، حيث تنطلق بسيارتها وتقابل في كل مرة بطريقها مجموعة من الشخصيات المختلفة وجرائم غريبة تسعى لحلها.

resident-evil.title: Resident Evil
resident-evil.synopsis: في إطار من الرعب والخيال العلمي، تدور الأحداث بعد عدة عقود من اكتشاف فايروس تي، حيث يتسبب اكتشاف جديد في كشف أسرارا مظلمة حول منظمة أمبريلا.

schitts-creek.title: Schitt's Creek
schitts-creek.synopsis: المسلسل الذي نال إعجاب النقاد وأحبته الجماهير في كل أنحاء العالم، تدور سلسلة الكوميديا الناجحة عن داراما التحول من الثراء إلى الفقر لعائلة روز التي لا مثيل لها.

the-island.title: The Island
the-island.synopsis: عندما قُتل شقيقه ، غادر ضابط شرطة لوس أنجلوس (مايكل ج. وايت) المدينة ليعود إلى الجزيرة التي نشأ فيها. سعيًا وراء الإجابات والانتقام في النهاية ، سرعان ما وجد نفسه في معركة دامية مع رجل الأعمال الفاسد الذي استولى على جزيرة الفردوس.

troll.title: Troll
troll.synopsis: عندما يتسبّب انفجار في الجبال النرويجية بإيقاظ غول قديم، يُعيِّن المسؤولون عالِمة حفريات لا تهاب أي شيء لإيقافه قبل أن ينشر الدمار والموت.

cast.name: Dennis Storhøi
cast.character: Chief of Defence General Sverre Lunde
